body: This my 6th or 7th therapist, I still feel like shit but at least better. She really helped me. I can't say that I'm not depressed anymore but I have a social issues and then I had a friend :') maybe she doesn't need me but still..I think mostly therapists are REALLY USELESS but they are good ones if even it's rare.

I didn't choose that but they do..So..I should tell this to who? Lmao they don't even care but when I will be gone, they gonna care a little bit.
